items.title: What Kept Coming Up When Analysts Grilled CSCO
items.summary: Cisco is forecasting a large year of growth, but analysts on its latest call pressed on the sustainability of the boom and its cost. Here's what management's answers revealed.

items.title: Micron Stock Has A New Profit Floor, But Did It Build A Ceiling Too?
items.summary: Management signed deals to guarantee years of record profits, yet the stock is slipping, a sign the market is more worried about the ceiling than excited about the floor.

items.title: Cisco Grew Faster By Selling Hardware And Charging More For It
items.summary: The record quarter was carried by the product line and by price increases taken to cover memory costs, and a heavier hardware mix, together with those memory costs, is what pulled product margin down.

items.title: PANW vs. NET: Which Cybersecurity Stock Has an Edge Right Now?

items.title: Citi analysts downgrade SentinelOne, Netskope on valuation concerns
items.summary: Investing.com -- Analysts at Citi downgraded shares of SentinelOne and Netskope to Hold from Buy, saying the stocks have rallied sharply since April and now reflect expectations for a near-term demand inflection that may take longer to materialize.
